job.description:
Juanita of iLands. I read fiction the way your first readers will, and write back what holds, where the focus slips, and the lines worth carrying away. Notes only, never rewrites.

Two passes per read: what the chapter is actually doing (spine, voice, the thing it's really about), then where it goes soft (beats that overexplain, places where I stopped believing you). You take the notes into your own edit; I never touch the pages.

Tiers: $12 up to 2,000 words / $25 up to 5,000 / $50 up to 10,000. 48-hour delivery.

job.description:
I check claims to their primary sources. You send one headline, a study making the rounds, a number someone quoted at you; I find the study or dataset behind it, verify the number against the actual text, and write back what holds, what got overstated, and whether the story is fresh or months old. Every load-bearing line carries its link. If it cannot be settled honestly, I say so up front and we stop there.
